description: Three bounded low-voltage topology proposals with independent graph and first-order calculation gates.

tasks.requirements: 5 V source, unloaded output, first-order low-pass, nominal cutoff 100 Hz, one resistor and one capacitor.
tasks.prompt: Design a passive first-order RC low-pass filter for a 5 V source, with an unloaded output and nominal cutoff of 100 Hz. Use one resistor and one capacitor, choose standard E12 values, and provide the complete exact pin-to-net graph. Use references R1, C1, VIN, VOUT and GND. Pins are R1 A/B, C1 A/B, VIN 1, VOUT 1, GND 1. Include three nets named VIN, VOUT and GND. Return JSON only using the supplied response schema.

tasks.requirements: 5 V nominal source, red indicator LED current 2-4 mA, one series resistor, grounded return.
tasks.prompt: Design a 5 V nominal red indicator LED circuit targeting 2-4 mA with exactly one series current-limiting resistor. Assume LED forward voltage 1.8-2.2 V. Use references R1, D1, VIN, GND and OUT. Pins are R1 A/B, D1 A/K, VIN 1, GND 1, OUT 1. Provide the complete exact pin-to-net graph and values; include nets VIN, LED_NODE and GND. OUT is an optional observation port on the LED anode node. Return JSON only using the supplied response schema.

tasks.requirements: 5 V NE555 astable near 2 Hz; 555 output drives a red LED through a series resistor; no external clock.
tasks.prompt: Design a 5 V NE555 astable oscillator near 2 Hz. Use the standard astable connection: pins 2 and 6 share the timing node, pin 7 lies between charge and discharge resistors, and a timing capacitor returns from the timing node to ground. Add a red output LED with a series resistor on pin 3. Use references U1, R1 (charge resistor), R2 (discharge resistor), C1, R3 (LED resistor), D1, VIN, GND and OUT. U1 pins are numbered 1 through 8; pin 1=GND, 2=TRIG, 3=OUT, 4=RESET, 5=CTRL, 6=THRESH, 7=DISCH, 8=VCC. D1 pins are A/K; each resistor and capacitor has A/B; ports VIN, GND and OUT have pin 1. Return exact values and the complete graph. Return JSON only using the supplied response schema.
